entities.name: René Ngongo
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: René Ngongo is a Congolese biologist, environmentalist and political activist. Ngongo graduated from the University of Kisangani with a bachelor's degree in biology in 1987. In 1994, he created the NGO OCEAN in order to protect the DRC's natural resources.

entities.name: René Ngongo
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: René Ngongo is a Congolese biologist, environmentalist and political activist. Ngongo graduated from the University of Kisangani with a bachelor's degree in biology in 1987. In 1994, he created the NGO OCEAN in order to protect the DRC's natural resources.
